literature_variants.name: CBG Null/Adelaide
literature_variants.as_reported: premature termination codon corresponding to residue -12 of the procorticosteroid-binding globulin molecule (c.121G-->A)
literature_variants.reported_effect: no immunoreactive CBG in homozygotes; ~50% CBG in heterozygotes
literature_variants.structural_class: premature termination within the signal peptide: no steroid-binding serpin fold can be made (null allele)

literature_variants.name: CBG Santiago
literature_variants.as_reported: c.13delC ... frameshift generating a stop codon within the signal peptide coding region (p.Leu5CysfsX26)
literature_variants.reported_effect: 50% reduced CBG levels in heterozygotes
literature_variants.structural_class: premature termination within the signal peptide: no steroid-binding serpin fold can be made (null allele)

literature_variants.name: CBG Montevideo
literature_variants.reported_effect: plasma CBG reduced ~50% in heterozygous proband and mother
literature_variants.structural_class: premature termination at 14% of the precursor: no steroid-binding serpin fold can be made (null allele)

literature_variants.name: CBG Leuven (L93H)
literature_variants.reported_effect: reduced cortisol-binding affinity (recombinant Kd 2.24 vs 0.64 nM)
literature_variants.structural_class: buried residue remote from the steroid site (fold stability / secretion)

literature_variants.name: CBG Lyon (D367N)
literature_variants.reported_effect: about 4-fold lower cortisol-binding affinity (PMID:10634411); no measurable cortisol binding of the recombinant protein in a later study (PMID:22948765)
literature_variants.structural_class: buried residue within the second shell of the steroid site

literature_variants.name: CBG G237V
literature_variants.as_reported: c.776g>t transversion in exon 3 ... p.Gly237Val substitution
literature_variants.reported_effect: immunoreactive CBG present but no cortisol-binding capacity
literature_variants.structural_class: second-shell residue whose side chain packs against steroid-contact residue(s) H368

literature_variants.name: CBG Athens (W371S)
literature_variants.as_reported: c.1282G>C transversion in exon 5 ... p.Trp393Ser (W371S) substitution
literature_variants.reported_effect: no measurable cortisol-binding activity; normal immunoreactive CBG
literature_variants.structural_class: direct steroid contact residue (first shell)
